name: date-picker-demo
title: Date Picker demo
description: A button that opens a calendar to pick a date, and closes once one is picked.

files.content:
import { DatePipe } from '@angular/common'; import { Component, signal } from '@angular/core'; import { NdIcon } from '@ndop/core'; import { Calendar, CalendarCaption, CalendarCell, CalendarDay, CalendarGrid, CalendarHeading, CalendarMonth, CalendarMonths, CalendarNav, CalendarNext, CalendarPrevious, CalendarWeek, CalendarWeekday, CalendarWeekdays, } from '@/ui/calendar/calendar'; import { DatePickerTrigger } from '@/ui/date-picker/date-picker'; import { Popover, PopoverContent, PopoverPortal, PopoverTrigger, } from '@/ui/popover/popover'; /** * A button that opens a calendar to pick a date. Opening focuses the chosen * day; picking one closes the popover and returns focus to the button. */ @Component({ selector: 'example-date-picker-demo', imports: [ Calendar, CalendarCaption, CalendarCell, CalendarDay, CalendarGrid, CalendarHeading, CalendarMonth, CalendarMonths, CalendarNav, CalendarNext, CalendarPrevious, CalendarWeek, CalendarWeekday, CalendarWeekdays, DatePickerTrigger, DatePipe, NdIcon, Popover, PopoverContent, PopoverPortal, PopoverTrigger, ], template: `
@for (month of calendar.months(); track month.key) {
{{ month.label }}
@for ( weekday of calendar.weekdays(); track weekday.long ) { } @for (week of month.weeks; track week.key) { @for (day of week.days; track day.key) { } }
{{ weekday.short }}
}
`, }) export class DatePickerDemoExample { protected readonly open = signal(false); protected readonly date = signal(null); }
